issues: Black flap cells sat on a blurred grey fake dashboard whose blocks and small text competed with them; the frame was muddy with no key light
The cells were small (the row spanned ~55% of the frame) inside a lot of meaningless grey, so there was no sense of a station board
Every cell flipped exactly three times on the same beat, so the cascade read as a tidy digital animation rather than machinery
There was only one title row; once it settled the frame went dead with no closing beat
changes: Ember look (warm black, orange): a full night departure board is the subject, with warm black housing, top-edge highlight, inset recess, warm floor spill and a top light; the fake page background is gone

New layout: a DEPARTURES header with local time, a hero row of 128×176 flaps reading SHIP FASTER (132px glyphs, ~75% of frame width), and a second row of small flaps for flight RELEASE 4.0 and an orange BOARDING status
More mechanical flips: the board starts on blank leaves, each cell flips a seeded 3 to 6 times, every flip is a 4f gravity drop with shading, and each lands with a 6px clunk
Two-layer rhythm: the hero row cascades at 3f per cell, the small row relays in from 44f at 2f per cell with the status finishing last; duration 140 to 150f
Closing beat: the status cells bloom once in the accent and the status lamp lights and slowly breathes; a slow 1 to 1.045 push with a 4° to 1.2° tilt settling across the shot
